Commentary.Commentary: We are set to resume!

Right then! 186 to get in 300 balls, that is all that England need to go 1-0 in the series. Given their batting, it should be a walk in the park for them. Sri Lanka need Chameera to strike big and strike early if they are to make a game of it. Hasaranga has had a good game with the bat, but now his bowling is what matters. Will England chase it down? Or will Sri Lanka spring a surprise? We will find out. Do join us for the chase in a while.

England were right on the money from the very beginning. Woakes and Willey rocked the top order and had Sri Lanka on the mats. There was a nice partnership brewing but Woakes came back and broke that too. Wood bowled really well and went past the outside edge on numerous occasions but without any luck. Ali took the one wicket while Rashid had a tough day and was the most expensive bowler. Woakes was the pick of the bowlers as he took 4 wickets while Willey took 3. Towards the end, it was down to their fielding as there were a couple of run outs to finish things off.

Sri Lanka had a horror start with the bat. They were 46 for 3 at one point and a collapse seemed on the cards. But Perera and Hasaranga steadied the ship as they stitched a brilliant partnership of 99 runs. But Hasaranga fell at the wrong time while looking to up the ante. That triggered a collapse and Perera too fell soon while looking to score quick runs. After that, there wasn't much resistance by the lower order. They struggled to get runs on the board, the same way they struggled to communicate between the wickets. It was Karunaratne who helped the team reach a total of 185, as he was only the third batsman today to reach the double-figure mark. Overall, it was a very poor effort from them.

What a performance by England! They have been absolutely clinical and have restricted Sri Lanka to 185. They will be mighty pleased and would back their batsmen to chase it down. Sri Lanka had another tough game as their inexperienced batting order struggled big time.

OUT! RUN OUT! Oh my word, that is incredible by Sam Billings! Length ball, on off. Chamika Karunaratne tucks it to the mid-wicket region. Sam Billings runs in from the fence, collects the ball and nails the throw at the bowler's end. The umpire knows that the batsman is out and raises his finger. Sri Lanka end at 185!
Fuller ball, on off. Pushed to long on. Moeen Ali is slow to get to the ball and the batters get back for the second.
SIX! SMASHED! Curran bowls a length ball, on off. Chamika Karunaratne hammers it over the mid-wicket fence.
Length ball, on the pads. Praveen Jayawickrama gets hit on the pads as he looks to flick it.
FOUR! What a shot! Fuller ball, on off. Praveen Jayawickrama flicks it to the mid-wicket fence.
Slower full toss, perhaps a yorker gone wrong. Praveen Jayawickrama defends it.
Serves a yorker, on off. Praveen Jayawickrama keeps it out.
Length ball, outside off. Left alone.
Slower length ball, outside off. Chamika Karunaratne slaps it to third man. There was again some lapse in communication but they decided to take the single.
Too wide for Praveen Jayawickrama to offer a stroke to this one.
Good length ball, wide outside off. Left alone.
Good length ball, on off. Chamika Karunaratne pushes it to long on for one.
Shorter ball, on off. Chamika Karunaratne ducks under it.
It will be Praveen Jayawickrama to walk in at No.11.

OUT! RUN OUT! This was on the cards! Length ball, on the pads. Dushmantha Chameera gets hit on the pads and the ball rolls to the off side. Now, Chamika Karunaratne is eager to get on the strike and runs past Dushmantha Chameera. The bails are taken off at the bowler's ends and Chameera is gone.
FOUR! Hammered! Length ball, on off. Dushmantha Chameera hammers it over Curran's head for a boundary.
Powerplay 2 is done! Now, 5 fielders can stay outside the ring till the end of the innings. Also, Sam Curran is back on.
Back of a length, outside off. Chamika Karunaratne pushes it to cover.
Fuller ball, on the pads. Clipped to the leg side.

Yorker, on the money, Chameera gets his blade down in time and digs it out. Chris Woakes makes a loud appeal for LBW but the umpire is unmoved. Although, there is confusion amongst the English side if it hit the boots or the bat? They have a little chat but Eoin Morgan says no and they don't go for the review.
BEATEN! Full length ball, outside off, Dushmantha Chameera hangs his bat out, as he looks to defend it. The ball nips away a bit as it beats the outside edge.
A full length ball, on off, Chamika Karunaratne tucks it to mid-wicket and scamper through for a single.
Serves a length ball, on off, Chamika Karunaratne blocks it back to the bowler.
Chris Woakes (8-5-11-4) is back on.
Length ball, on off, Chameera is solid in his defense.
On off, kept out.
A full length ball, on off, Chameera defends it to point.
Review time! Eoin Morgan has reviewed this for LBW. There is a spike as the ball passes the bat.

NOT OUT! There was a spike that saved the batsman. Full length ball, around middle and leg. Comes back in. Chameera looks to defend but misses and gets rapped on the pads. Willey makes a loud appeal for LBW, but the umpire is unmoved. Willey tells his captain that it has pitched in line, as Eoin Morgan decides to go with the bowler and takes the review. The replays show there was a spike as the ball passed the bat. Hence, the decision stands.
Full and on off, Chameera defends it to cover.
A length ball, on middle, Dushmantha Chameera looks to defend and gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Shorter ball, on off. Chamika Karunaratne ducks under it.
Fuller ball, outside off. Chamika Karunaratne chips it over cover for a couple.
Back of a length, on off. Chamika Karunaratne gets hit on the body as he looks to defend.
Just short! Length ball, just outside off. Chamika Karunaratne gets the outside edge but it lands just short of Joe Root at first slip.
Back of a length, around off. Chamika Karunaratne hops up to defend it.
Yorker, on off. Dushmantha Chameera pushes it to the off side for one.
A bouncer, on middle, Chamika Karunaratne ducks under this one.
A full length ball, on off, Chameera looks to defend but the ball goes towards third man via an outside edge. Chameera gets off the mark and gets a single.
BEATEN! On a length, outside off, Chameera looks to defend it but misses. As the ball zips past the outside edge.
Short ball, on middle, Chameera ducks under it.
Full, on middle, Dushmantha Chameera defends it to the leg side.
Dushmantha Chameera walks in at No. 10.

OUT! CAUGHT! David Willey gets into the action now, as he strikes for the third time. A slower short ball, on off, Binura Fernando hits it awkwardly towards the leg side. The ball goes in the air and towards Moeen Ali at mid-wicket, who strides forward and takes an easy catch to send back Fernando. Now it is a matter of time till the bowlers rattle out the tail-enders.
Commentary.Howout: c Moeen Ali b David Willey

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, on off. Defended out.
Serves a length ball, on the pads. Chamika Karunaratne clips it to the leg side.
Length ball, outside off. Left alone now.
Good length ball, on the pads. Binura Fernando clips it to deep square leg for one.
Length ball, wide outside off. Fernando goes for it but misses.
Length ball, on the pads. Clipped to deep square leg for one.
A single now. Length ball, on off. Chamika Karunaratne clips it to mid-wicket for one.
Fuller ball, on off. Pushed to mid off.
Fuller ball, on off. Chamika Karunaratne pushes it to cover.
Length ball, on off. Defended out.

Oh my word! They could have been run out again! Length ball, on off. Pushed to Billings at point, there is a fumble so Binura Fernando wants the single. But Chamika Karunaratne sends him back. Luckily for them, Sam Billings misses his shy at the bowler's end.
Length ball, on off. Defended out.
The umpire takes it upstairs, to confirm the RUN OUT. The replays confirm that the batsman was inside the crease. The final decision is NOT OUT.

Oh dear! NOT OUT!  It was poor communication from the batsmen. A length ball, outside off, Chamika Karunaratne goes back and guides it through point and they take a single. Looks like Chamika Karunaratne wanted the second run and he takes off. Liam Livingstone throws it at the keeper, but Jonny Bairstow is unable to grab that one and it goes through his gloves. Meanwhile, Chamika Karunaratne and Binura Fernando are at the same end. The miss by Jonny Bairstow allowed the former to get back to the other end, and he runs for his life. However, Jonny Bairstow chases the ball and hits the stumps at the bowler's end. The English players are delighted, as the umpire takes it upstairs. The replays show the batsman is inside the crease, as the bails are coming off. Chamika Karunaratne gets a lifeline here.
A length ball, on off, kept out.
BEATEN! Amazing stuff from Wood. A length ball, outside off, Chamika Karunaratne looks to push it to cover but misses.
A length ball, on off, Chamika Karunaratne defends it well.

WIDE! Back of a length ball, down the leg side. Chamika Karunaratne looks to flick it but misses. The ball zips past his gloves and create a minute sound. Jonny Bairstow behind the wickets think there was a nick and makes an appeal. But the umpire is unmoved and signalled it as a wide.

Another full length delivery, on off, Binura Fernando works it through cover for a single. Eoin Morgan collects the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but the ball goes past the stumps. Replays show that Binura Fernando would have been safe even if the ball hit the stumps.
Full length ball, outside off, Chamika Karunaratne pushes it through covers for a single.
Mark Wood (4-0-10-0) is back on. He has a slip in place.
A length ball, on off, Fernando is solid in his defense.
A full length ball, on off, Fernando defends it to the leg side via the inner half of the blade.
A bouncer, on the leg side, Fernando ducks under it.
A length ball, on middle, Chamika Karunaratne tucks it to mid-wicket and takes off for a single. Moeen Ali comes charging in but fails to collect the ball off the ground.
Binura Fernando is the next batsman.

OUT! TAKEN! The skipper goes as England are well on top now! Length ball, outside off. Perera decides to test these big square boundaries and looks to go over mid-wicket. He hits it quite well but not well enough to clear the ropes. Sam Billings takes it with ease and a very, very good knock by Kusal Perera comes to an end.
Commentary.Howout: c Sam Billings b David Willey

Commentary.Commentary: David Willey comes back into the attack.
Fuller ball, on off. Pushed to mid off.
Flatter ball, on off. Defended out.
Who will come out next? It is Chamika Karunaratne who walks in at No. 8.

Review. Dhananjaya Lakshan goes for the review. The on-field decision is OUT. The Ultra Edge shows that no bat is involved. The Ball Tracker shows umpire's call when the ball is hitting the stumps. The original decision stands.

OUT! LBW! It is umpire's call and Ramesh Mendis is gone! Tossed up, outside off. Mendis plants his foot forward to defend but the ball turns and hits his pad. He is struck on the front pad and that too right in the front of the middle stump. The umpire gives it a long hard thought before raising his finger. Mendis reviews this but it is umpire's call on hitting.
Flatter ball, short and wide outside off. Cut away to deep point for one.
Fuller ball, outside off. Mendis pushes it to long on for one.
An easy single as this is eased down to long off.
Loopy ball, on off. Clipped to the leg side.
A wicket maiden for Chris Woakes! Length ball, on off. Defended out now.
Back of a length, outside off. Mendis pushes it to point.
Length ball, outside off. Mendis gets hit high on the pads as he looks to defend.
Who will come out at No. 7? It is going to be Ramesh Mendis.

OUT! TAKEN! Not a day for debutants! First, Charith Asalanka went for a duck and now, Dhananjaya Lakshan goes back too! On the other hand, Chris Woakes is having a great day with the ball! Bowls it on a length, outside off. Lakshan looks to punch it but his feet go nowhere. He gets the outside edge and Joe Root takes a good catch at first slip, diving to his left.
Commentary.Howout: c Joe Root b Chris Woakes

Commentary.Commentary: Serves a length ball, just outside off. Lakshan punches it nicely to point.
Fuller ball, around off. Pushed to point now.
Full, on off, Lakshan sweeps it towards square leg and gets a run.
Loopy ball, on middle, Lakshan is solid in his defense.
On off, kept out.
Tossed up, on off, Lakshan stays back and defends it to cover.
Floated, on middle, Lakshan comes down  the track and blocks it watchfully.
Loopy ball, on off, Perera works it to cover and gets a single. Moves to 71.
Moeen Ali comes in the attack now.

Back of a length, outside off. Perera gets the inside edge as he looks to defend. The ball goes to short fine leg and Dhananjaya Lakshan insists on taking the quick run. There is a shy at the bowler's end but the fielder misses.
Off the mark! Fuller ball, on middle and leg. Lakshan clips it to fine leg for one.
Dhananjaya Lakshan is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Hasaranga was tempted with the height and he goes after it, but it proved to be costly. And look, it is Chris Woakes again, it is his third wicket for the day. He gets the main breakthrough, this is what the English side were after. Serves a short ball, on off, Hasaranga looks to pull it away but does not middle it. Infact, he hits it with the lower end of the bat. He was not in control of the shot. The ball flies high towards square leg. Liam Livingstone covers a lot of ground as he runs forward to his right and takes the catch with a forward slide. A composed innings by Wanindu Hasaranga comes to an end.
Commentary.Howout: c Liam Livingstone b Chris Woakes

Commentary.Commentary: Good length ball, on off, Hasaranga is solid in his defense.
On a length, around middle, Perera flicks it to mid-wicket and take a run.
A length ball, on off, Hasaranga punches it through covers for a run.
Back of a length ball, on the body line, Wanindu Hasaranga tucks it to the leg side and gets another single. Good running by the batters.
Good length, around middle, Perera pulls it to fine leg and gets a single.
A length ball, on off, Hasaranga guides it to third man for a single.
Serves a length ball, on off, Hasaranga defends it to the off side.
A short ball, on off, Perera pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run,
A full length ball, on off, Hasaranga pushes it to the right of the sweeper cover and gets a single.
David Willey (5-0-36-1) is back on.
Fuller ball, on off. Perera drills it straight to cover.
Slower length ball, outside off. Pushed to covers.
Fuller ball, on off. Perera gets the inside edge back on the pads as he looks to defend.
50 for Wanindu Hasaranga! What a solid knock he has played so far. A calm and composed knock was just what the team needed and he has done that. Fuller ball, on off. Pushed past cover for one.
Length ball, on the pads. Kusal Perera gets some pad on it and it rolls to the leg side. A leg bye is taken.
Good length ball, on off. Defended out.
Chris Woakes comes back into the attack now. His figures 5-4-6-2 so far.
Googly now, on off. Wanindu Hasaranga gets the inside edge back on the pads as he looks to defend.
FOUR! This is excellent batting from Wanindu Hasaranga! Rashid tosses this up, on off. Wanindu Hasaranga nicely hits it over mid off for a boundary. Moves to 49 now.
FOUR! Even better now! Nicely tossed up, outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga creams it past mid off as the ball races to the extra cover fence.
Flatter ball, on off. Defended out.
FOUR! Beautiful batting! Wanindu Hasaranga is playing really against Rashid. Loopy ball, on middle. He just lifts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Flatter ball, on the pads. Tucked to the leg side for one.
A length ball, on the pads, Perera flicks it to the leg side and gets another single. Moves to 65.
A touch short, on off, Perera defends it to point. And shouts 'NO' straightaway for the run.
A full length ball, on middle. Hasaranga flicks it to deep mid-wicket for another single. This is smart batting.
FOUR! Sheer timing! A length ball, on off, Hasaranga punches it with soft hands through the cover and gets a boundary.
Serves a full length ball, around middle, Perera flicks it through the mid-wicket region for a run.
A full length ball, on the pads, Wanindu Hasaranga tucks it towards fine leg and gets a single.
Flatter, short and on off, Wanindu Hasaranga pulls it to wide of long on for a single.
Full, on middle, Perera clips it to mid-wicket for another single.
Tossed up, full and on off, Hasaranga drives it uppishly past the bowler, towards mid off and gets a single.
Floated, outside off, Perera drives it through covers for another single.
Flatter, on off, Hasaranga stays in his crease and pushes it to cover for a run.
Floated full and on off, Perera sweeps it to deep square leg for a run.
Good length ball, outside off, Hasaranga defends it to point.
Oh, Beauty! A length ball, outside off, nipping away. Hasaranga looks to poke it but misses. The ball zips past the outside edge.
Full and on the pads, Perera removes his front leg and clips it to mid-wicket for another single.
A length ball, around middle, Hasaranga tucks it to fine leg and scampers through for a run.
A length ball, on the pads, Wanindu Hasaranga hops and tucks it through square leg. The batters come back comfortably for the second run.
Full length ball, on the pads, Perera flicks it to deep square leg and gets a single.

Nicely played. Tossed up, on off, Wanindu Hasaranga chips it over the mid off fielder and the ball lands in a vacant area. Two taken as he didn't try to hit it too hard and the fielder from mid off gets the ball in time.
Floated, on off, Perera sweeps it to deep mid-wicket and gets a single.
Loopy ball, around middle, Hasaranga goes back and punches it through the cover region for a single.
Floated on off, Perera flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted on off, Perera looks to flick but gets an outside edge as the ball rolls to short third man.
Loopy ball, on off, Perera defends it to cover.
Serves a fuller one, on off. Wanindu Hasaranga pushes it to cover with ease.
Fuller ball, on off. Perera punches it past cover and gets to the other end.
A full length ball, around middle. Perera defends it out solidly.
Another unplayable delivery! This is gorgeous! A length ball, on off, nips away a little. Perera looks to defend, but ends up losing his balance as the ball beats the outside edge.
Beaten! What a beauty! On a length, outside off, keeping the line of the delivery. Perera looks to defend but zips past the outside edge.
The physio is out there as Kusal Perera has been hit on the left bicep.

OUCH! That must have hurt. The extra bounce troubles the skipper yet again. A length ball, on off, it gets an extra bounce off the pitch. Perera hops and looks to defend, but the goes onto hit him on his bicep. He goes down in pain.
Googly, outside off. Kusal Perera clips it through square leg for one.

FOUR! Nicely swept! Loopy ball, outside off. Kusal Perera nails the sweep. The ball goes towards deep mid-wicket. David Willey runs across to his left and even dives but his effort is not good enough to stop the ball.
Flatter ball, on the pads. Wanindu Hasaranga gets some pad on it and the ball goes to the leg side. A single is taken.
Flatter ball, on off. Pushed to covers.
SIX! Wanindu Hasaranga has hit that so well! Tossed up, on middle. He gets low and slog sweeps it over the mid-wicket fence. Just over the ropes.

50 for Kusal Perera! The skipper has led from the front and will look to score a big one now. His second 50 against England and it comes at a crucial time. Loopy ball, on the pads. Kusal Perera clips it wide of short third man for one.
Digs this one short and wide outside off. Left alone now.
Comes 'round the stumps now and bowls a length ball, on off. Wanindu Hasaranga pushes it to point.
Bowls it on a length, outside off. Turned to the leg side for one.
The physio comes out to have a look at Kusal Perera's finger. As he got hit on his gloves. He still looks a bit uncomfortbale, but he decides to continue anyway.

Extra bounce there! Curran comes over the stumps and bowls it back of a length. This one comes back in and also bounces a lot more than Kusal Perera expected. He was lining up for the cut shot, but he was taken by surprise and gets hit on the gloves.
Serves a length ball, around off. Wanindu Hasaranga nicely runs it to third man for one.
Good length ball, on the pads. Tucked away towards deep square leg for one.
Sam Curran comes back into the attack now. He changes ends now. Replaces Mark Wood.
Googly again. Outside off now, Wanindu Hasaranga pushes it to mid-wicket.
Googly, outside off. Perera sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for one.
This is good cricket. The boundary is followed by a single. Loopy ball, on off. Pushed down to long off for one by Wanindu Hasaranga.

FOUR! All he had to do is clear the man at mid on and he did with ease! Loopy ball, on off. Wanindu Hasaranga clears his front leg and hammers it to the long on fence. Good shot to relieve some pressure.
Fuller ball, on off. Clipped to the leg side for one.
Nicely tossed up, around off. Perera pushes it to the off side.
Length ball, outside off. Pushed to covers now.
Wood is all over Hasaranga at this moment. He has absolutely no clue what to do against the pacer. Back of a length, outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga is beaten as he looks to push it.
Three in a row! The same delivery yields the same result as Wanindu Hasaranga is still not comfortable with his foot movement.

Beaten again! Mark Wood is keeping the fielder at first slip in play here. Length ball, outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga is stuck in the crease as he looks to defend it. The ball zips past the outside edge yet again.
Beaten! Hurls a shorter ball, just outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga pokes at it but the ball zips past the outside edge.
Fuller ball, down the leg side. Perera works it down to fine leg for a single now.
Flatter ball, around off. Wanindu Hasaranga defends it well.
Darted down the leg side now. Rashid has to reload as the umpire calls it a wide.
Loopy ball, around off. Defended out.
Googly now, on off. Wanindu Hasaranga defends it out. Kumar Sangakkara is in the commentary box and he is picking the googly while sitting there. What a legend.
Nicely tossed up, on middle and leg. Perera shimmies down the track and whips it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up, outside off. Perera pushes it to cover. This was a googly but Perera read it early.
Loopy ball, around off. Perera defends it off the front foot.

Drinks Break! A good start for the hosts as they pegged back the Sri Lankan order cheaply. The bowlers would now look to pick a few quick wickets to get into the tail. For Sri Lanka, Kusal Perera remains the key as he has batted really well so far and would want to score a big one. Adil Rashid comes into the attack now to work his spin. Replacing Sam Curran.
A single to end the over. Fullish and on middle, Perera flicks it to square leg for a run.
Full and on off, Perera drives it to mid off. He was looking for a run, but was sent back immediately.
A full length ball, on off, Hasaranga nudges it to mid-wicket and gets a single.
A length ball, around the hips, Perera works it to short fine leg for a single.
Back of a length ball, on off, Perera ducks under it. That was a pacy ball.
Angles in a full length ball, on off, Perera defends it back to the bowler off the front foot.
Fuller length, on off, Hasaranga pushes it to point.
A length ball, around middle, Perera tucks it to mid-wicket and takes off for a single.
A full length ball, on middle, Hasarange flicks it to fine leg for a run.
BEATEN! Good length ball, outside off. The ball takes off after pitching. Wanindu Hasaranga looks to push it away but misses, as the ball bounces over his blade.
Good length ball, on middle, Perera pulls it to square leg for a single. The Free Hit doesn't cost much then.
Back of a length, wide outside off. Perera pulls it across the line. The ball goes wide of deep mid-wicket and they get a couple. Looks like Wood has overstepped so the next ball will be a Free Hit.
Bowls it on a length, on the pads. Wanindu Hasaranga clips it to deep backward square leg for one.

BEATEN! WOW! What a delivery by Mark Wood. He is making the ball dance. A good length ball, pitching on middle, swinging away. Perera looks to defend but misses. The ball moves away after pitching and beats the outside edge. It also goes over the off stump just by a whisker. Perera is lucky to still be on the pitch.
Full length ball, on off, Wanindu Hasaranga opens the face of the bat and guides it to third man for a single.

Back of a length ball, outside off, Wanindu Hasaranga lets it go through to the keeper. This is a new challenge for Wanindu Hasaranga as he isn't used to someone bowling at 150 kmph at him. Will be interesting to see how he rises to the challenge.
On a length, comes back in from outside off, Wanindu Hasaranga defends it to point.
Full length ball, around middle, Perera flicks it through square leg and gets a single.
Serves a length ball, on off, angles back in as Wood is coming 'round the wicket. Perera defends it out watchfully.
Fullish, around middle and leg, Hasaranga defends it to the leg side.
FOUR! Nicely struck! Overpitched ball, outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga leans into and punches it past point. The fielder from point chases it and even slides for it, but the ball wins the race.
WIDE! Short ball,around off. Wanindu Hasaranga ducks under it. Wide given.
On a length, outside off, Hasaranga looks to heave it away, but manages to get a thick outside edge. The balls goes past Joe Root in the slip towards third man. The batters take a couple.
A length ball, on off, Hasaranga defends it out solidly.
LEG BYE! Full and on the pads, Perera misses his flick yet again. The ball clips the pads and goes to the leg side. Leg Bye.
Full and on off, Perera defends it to cover.
Sam Curran comes in the attack now.
LEG BYE! A length ball, on the pads, Perera misses his flick. The ball rolls towards fine leg after clipping the pads. The batters sneak a single. Leg Bye given.
On a length, around off, Perera works it to mid on.
A full length ball, on off, Perera works it back to the bowler. Wood stops the ball brilliantly with his left foot.
A length ball, on off, Perera drives it to mid off.
A full length ball, on the pads, Perera misses his flick and gets hit on the pads.

EDGY FOUR! A full length ball, outside off, Perera swings his blade and gets a thick outside edge. As the ball goes through the slip region for a boundary at third man. Luckily there were no slips placed otherwise Sri Lanka would have lost their most experienced batter.
Powerplay 1 is done! Now, only 4 fielders can stay outside the ring till the 40th over. Also, Mark Wood comes in the attack.
Good length ball, on off, Wanindu Hasaranga blocks it to the off side. Just a single off the over.
A full length ball, on the pads, Hasaranga flicks it to the left of Jonny Bairstow.
Ah..that was close! A full length ball, on off, Wanindu Hasaranga looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls past the off stump towards point.
A length ball, on off, Hasaranga is solid in his defense.
A loud appeal for LBW but turned down. A fuller length ball, lands on middle, coming back in. Wanindu Hasaranga looks to flick it but misses and gets rapped on the pads. Going down leg probably.
In the airrr...but safe! Length ball, wide outside off. Perera throws his hands at it but his feet barely moved. The ball takes the splice of the bat and lands short of third man as they take one.
Good length ball, on off, Wanindu Hasaranga drives it to cover.
On a length, outside off, Hasaranga works it to cover.
Full ball, on middle, Wanindu Hasaranga defends it to the leg side.
Serves a length ball, on off. Wanindu Hasaranga blocks it from the crease.
Length ball, around off. Wanindu Hasaranga pushes it to point.
Wanindu Hasaranga walks out to bat at No. 5.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! This is an absolute JAFFA! Dasun Shanaka couldn't do anything about it. Chris Woakes strikes again and gets his second man of the day. He is rattling the new batsmen, and not letting them settle at all. Serves a length ball, on off, this one nips away. Shanaka looks to defend it but fails, as the ball takes the outside edge and flies to the right of Jonny Bairstow. The man with the gloves takes it with ease.
Commentary.Howout: c Jonny Bairstow b Chris Woakes

Commentary.Commentary: Two more! A length ball, outside off, Perera cuts it over square leg. Adil Rashid collects the ball safely. Two taken.
Fuller and on middle, Perere flicks it to sqaure leg and gets a couple.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Overpitched, outside off, Perera cuts it through the point region for a boundary. This is good batting by the skipper.

FOUR! SLAPPED! Good length ball, outside off, Perera punches it through cover. Liam Livingstone dives to his right to make a half stop. But the ball was hit with sheer power as it races towards the boundary.

A full length delivery, around middle, nips in, Shanaka looks to flick it but misses and the balls rolls to the leg side off the pads. There was an appeal made by David Willey, but the umpire is unmoved. Leg Bye given.
WIDE! A full length ball, down the leg side. Shanaka misses his flick. Wide called.
A length ball, around off, Perera tucks it through mid-wicket. The batters take three. Good running.
Fuller, around off, Dasun Shanaka looks to drive but the ball comes in and goes off the toe end of his bat towards mid on.
Fuller in length, outside off, driven straight to mid off.
On a length, outside off, Shanaka again works it to mid off.
Full and outside off, Shanaka drives it to mid off.
A length ball, outside off, left alone by Shanaka.

FOUR LEG BYES! A back of a length ball down the leg side. Shanaka looks to flick but misses. The ball beats the diving keeper as well. It races towards the fine leg boundary. The fielder makes a diving effort, but was in contact with the boundary line as he cuts the ball off. Leg byes given.
The next batsman walking in at No. 4 is Dasun Shanaka. Will he be able to stick around with the skipper?

Edged to get off the mark! Full and wide outside off. Dasun Shanaka surprisingly decides to go for it on his very first ball. He goes at it with his hands, but his feet are glued to the crease. The ball goes past the second slip and runs to third man for one. Just the 2 runs and the wicket from the over.

OUT! TAKEN! The debut is not a good one for Charith Asalanka! David Willey drags his length just a bit and bowls it in the corridor of uncertainty. There is some extra bounce on that one, plus Charith Asalanka played it away from his body. So, all he gets is the outside edge. Joe Root takes a good catch to his left at first slip.
Commentary.Howout: c Joe Root b David Willey

Commentary.Commentary: There are so many types of slower balls developed by fast bowlers. Chris Woakes is no exception. The ball on which Pathum Nissanka got out, was not far different from the normal balls he usually bowls. He did not roll his fingers over the seam nor did he change his wrist position. All he did was kept the seam upright and then covered it. And then, he just angled it in. Seems so easy to make and spot changes of pace but you can see the effort put in behind the same.
Another good front foot defence by Charith Asalanka. He has looked pretty good with his defence so far.
Lands it on a length, around off. Pushed to the off side.
Serves a fuller ball, just outside off. Charith Asalanka defends it nicely. Stil to get off the mark in ODI cricket.

Just a single now. Fuller ball, on off. Pushed past mid on for one. Kusal Perera needs to play a big knock here, he is the only player in the team to have played over 100 ODIs. So he needs to make his experience count.
A touch shorter, around off. Charith Asalanka pulls it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller ball, around off. Defended out.
Who will come out next? Oh, it is the debutant Charith Asalanka who makes his way in at No. 3. It is his ODI debut and he finds himself batting in a tricky situation. Two slips in place for him.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a poor stroke by Pathum Nissanka! David Llyod calls it a 'cunning plan' on air! So, Chris Woakes bowls a nice slower one, it is also short in length and outside off. It deserves to be dispatched to the fence. Pathum Nissanka realizes this and goes for it, but he gets it off the toe end of the blade and Moeen Ali takes an easy catch at mid-wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Moeen Ali b Chris Woakes

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, around off. Pushed to covers now.

Great scenes at the Chester-le-Street before the start of the game. It is always a proud moment for a father to congratulate or commemorate his son's achievements, isn't it? Before the start of play, David Willey was handed a cap by his father, Peter Willey, in front of the entire squad. Is he making his debut, you ask? Oh no, folks. He is playing his 50th ODI. So the management decided to make it a bit special for both, father and son. Great gesture by the ECB.
Well bowled. Lands it on a length, just outside off. Nissanka takes half-a-stride forward looking to defend it, but the ball nips back in and hits him high on the pads.
Back of a length, around off. Nissanka blocks it out off the back foot.
BEATEN! This was close. Straighter, on a length, on off. Perera looks to work it over the off side but misses. The ball though zips past the inside edge into the keeper's mitts.
On off, Perera is solid in his defense.
A touch full, outside off, Perera pushes it over point and gets a couple.

EDGY FOUR! A good length ball, on off, Perera looks to works this over mid on. But only manages to get an inside edge as the ball goes past over the off stump. It beats Jonny Bairstow behind the stumps and rushes towards the boundary at fine leg.
A length ball, on off, Perera defends it solidly.
Play and a miss! On a length, around off, angling away. Perera lookds to drive it away but misses.
Nicely played. Back of a length, around off. Nissanka punches it past cover for a couple.
Serves a length ball, around off. Punched to covers now.
Length ball, down the leg side. Nissanka fails to get any bat on it. Wide called.

BREAKING NEWS - Cricket fans would already be aware that Sri Lanka have decided to call back three players - Kusal Mendis, Danushka Gunathilaka and Niroshan Dickwella - for breaching player protocols. Add to it, Avishka Fernando is already ruled out due to an injury. But the hosts have some withdrawals as well. After the first T20I, Jos Buttler made himself unavailable for the entire white-leg tour, due to an injury and in the latest news, as confirmed by Michael Atherton on air, DAWID MALAN has withdrawn himself from the ODI squad, due to personal reasons. So today's game sees England a bit more bowling heavy.
Beaten! Just as I say that this one swings a bit! Length ball, lands on off and nips away just enough to beat the outside edge as Nissanka looks to defend.
Bowls a fuller one, on the pads. Nissanka flicks it through square leg for a couple. The swing seems to have disappeared now.
Back of a length, around off. This is pushed towards mid on. Nissanka wanted the single but his skipper is not interested.
Fuller ball, on off. Nissanka covers his stumps and plays this to point.
Short ball, down the leg side. Pathum Nissanka misses his pull. Wide called. Someone appeals for a catch but the bowler is not interested. Neither is the umpire.
FOUR! Lovely stroke! Overpitched ball, outside off. Perera just punches it past covers for a boundary.
Off the mark! Length ball, outside off. Nissanka opens the blade and runs it to third man for one.
Fuller again, on the pads. Nissanka strides into it and clips it to mid-wicket.
Bowls a full one, angling away from the right-hander. Left alone now.
A touch fuller, on off. Perera tucks it to the leg side for one.
FOUR! Off the mark with a boundary! Short and wide outside off. Perera latches on it and cuts it over covers for a boundary.
First runs off the game! Willey bowls a length ball, way down the leg side. Wide called.
Who will bowl with the second new ball? David Willey it is.
Yes, he does! Woakes lets it go on a length, around off. There is some away shape but Nissanka nicely pushes it to point.
Back of a length, outside off. Punched to covers. Can he start off with a maiden here?
A touch fuller, on the pads now. Nissanka clips it to mid-wicket.
Lets it go on a length, around off. Nissanka defends it off the back foot.
Some swing there. Length ball, lands outside off and shapes away as Nissanka leaves it alone.
Woakes starts by serving a length ball, around off. Pathum Nissanka blocks it out nicely.
We are set to begin! The England players have made their way out on the field. Followed by Kusal Perera and Pathum Nissanka who come out to bat. It will be Chris Woakes who will start with the ball.

Sri Lanka (PLAYING XI) - Kusal Perera (WK & C), Pathum Nissanka, Charith Asalanka (ODI DEBUT), Dasun Shanaka, Wanindu Hasaranga, Ramesh Mendis, Dhananjaya Lakshan (ODI DEBUT), Chamika Karunaratne, Binura Fernando, Dushmantha Chameera, Praveen Jayawickrama (ODI DEBUT).
England (PLAYING XI) - Jonny Bairstow (WK), Liam Livingstone, Joe Root, Eoin Morgan (C), Sam Billings, Moeen Ali, Chris Woakes, Sam Curran, David Willey, Adil Rashid, Mark Wood.
TOSS - The coin goes up and falls in the favour of England, as they opt to field first.

Hello and a warm welcome to the first ODI between England and Sri Lanka. After a drubbing in the T20Is, Sri Lanka would be keen to get back to winning ways. But their recent form and team strength both are no match to England. The hosts go in as the firm favorites but anything can happen in cricket. Will England continue their dominance or will Sri Lanka spring a surprise? We will find out. Toss and teams in a bit.
